alertData.description:
{@link FetchResult} with the `alert` data for the scenario.

This data is not {@link Persistable} and represents {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s generated by the scenario.
(this means the alerts are not persisted in the database).

The schema for each `alert` is:
- `id`: UUID generated for the alert, this is required because even though the alerts are not persisted, the UI
        needs a unique identifier for each alert to render them correctly.
- `timestamp`: The {@link DateTime} when the alert was generated.
- `name`: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#alertOutputs} name for the alert.
- `primaryModelOutput`: A `number` representing the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#algorithmOutputs} for the alert.
- `featureContributions`: An array of objects representing the feature contributions for the alert.
                          Each object has the following fields:
  - `featureName`: The {@link Feature#id} of the feature.
  - `contribution`: Normalized (`0-1`) value of the feature contribution for the alert.
  - `sensorId`: If found, it will contain the related {@link Sensor#id}.
  - `actualValue`: The numerical value of the feature at the time of the alert.

chartData.description:
{@link UiApTimeseriesChartDataConfig} containing the timeseries data for the scenario, with its events
shaded areas (to mark the scenario time range) for the UI Chart.
